text:
incident-bot: Pager: spike in 5xx rate at api-gateway-prod (edge) detected 09:12 UTC. Mixed 502/504 observed. Rolling 5m error rate = 14% (P1). Creating incident thread.
Jordan P: I'm on gateway logs. Seeing lots of upstream reset + read timeout. Will dump recent tails.
Lin S: checking model-inference pool and cache tier. Not seeing OOMs but cache hit-rate plummeted for a set of keys.
Omar G: load view: sudden increase from one client cluster (client-42) sending large multi-chunk prompts. Throughput to model-backend up x3.
Jordan P: gateway logs snippet: 
```
[09:11:58] gateway|req=aa1 status=502 upstream=10.5.12.8:8080 err="upstream reset"
[09:12:05] gateway|req=bb2 status=504 upstream=10.5.12.9:8080 latency=32.7s
[09:12:20] gateway|req=cc3 status=502 upstream=10.5.12.10:8080 err="write failed"
```
Marta H: customer impact: multiple errors reported in APAC & EU; mobile SDK sees retries and user-facing errors. I'm drafting a brief incident note for status.redwood.ai.
Lin S: cache tier (redis-ephemeral) hit rate dropped to 6% from usual 78% for embedding prefix set. Suspect eviction storm due to a traffic shift.
Omar G: model-backend pod metrics: cx_queue and accept_count show saturation. 95th percentile service latency rising. Some pods report short fd exhaustion (EMFILE).
Jordan P: mitigation brainstorm: 1) enable short-term token-bucket rate limit for client-42 at edge, 2) enable model-proxy circuit-breaker for overloaded upstreams, 3) route heavy/streaming requests to dedicated stream cluster, 4) return informative 429/503 for huge payloads rather than hang. Prefer to avoid cross-region shuffles until we stabilize.
Dana M: I'm 10m into shift. I'll take over once we stabilize. For now I can help push config changes.
Lin S: implementing quick fix: pin hot keys into a separate small in-memory LRU cache on model-proxy to avoid redis thundering. Deploying now.
incident-bot: Config job queued: proxy-hotkey-cache-v1. Applying to prod.
Omar G: adding temporary rate limit rule for client-42: `limit_req zone=clients burst=50 nodelay` at 09:18.
Jordan P: adding circuit breaker to upstream cluster model-pool-a: max_connections=30, max_pending_requests=40. Pushing with gateway rollout.
Jordan P: applied. Observed immediate reduction in new upstream connections. 5xx rate dropped from 14% -> 7% in 3m.
Lin S: in-memory hotkey cache deployed. Redis request rate for the hotset decreased ~70%. Backend queue depth dropping.
Marta H: posted update to status page: "Investigating increased 502/504 errors affecting API requests. We've applied mitigations and are monitoring. No ETA yet."
Omar G: however we're still seeing long-tail 504s from pods with fd errors. Suspect kernel-level ulimit causing accept() failure under burst. Working on pod restart + adjust system ulimits.
Jordan P: restart rolling of model-backend pods scheduled now with a small pause to avoid thundering. Command: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/model-backend -n inference --max-unavailable=1`
Dana M: executing restart on two pods now. Also increasing fs.file-max and container ulimit to 65536 on new pods.
incident-bot: Restart jobs running.
Jordan P: after restarts and rate limits, error rate now ~2.8%. Still watching for tail 504s from legacy auth-proxy.
Lin S: found that large multipart requests with header `X-Long-Request: yes` are getting queued long-running backend tasks. Adding a validation rule to reject >1MB payloads with a clear 413 + Retry-After.
Omar G: applied validation filter at 09:35. Observed fewer huge tasks entering pipeline. 5xxs trending down further.
Marta H: prepping customer outreach: guidance to backoff aggressive retry loops and recommend exponential backoff. Drafting targeted messages for top affected customers.
Dana M: handoff note for next-oncall (Priya on rotation):
- Incident start: 09:12 UTC, gateway 5xx spike due to client-42 traffic surge + cache eviction storm + fd limits on model nodes.
- Actions taken: hotkey in-memory cache; client-specific rate-limit; upstream circuit-breaker; rolling restart for model-backend + increased ulimits; payload validation for oversized requests; routing not changed across regions.
- Current state: error rate stabilized ~1.9% across regions, major customers report fewer failures. Monitoring for 20m, preparing RCA.
Priya K: ack I'll monitor. If error rate rises above 5% reopen pager.
Jordan P: capturing traces and saving to s3://redwood-incidents/2812349999/ including tcpdump snippets and docker stats.
Lin S: collecting heapshots and redis eviction logs.
Marta H: will follow up with a customer-impact spreadsheet and attach to postmortem.
incident-bot: Incident status: monitoring. Escalation timer set for 10:12 UTC.
Dana M: nice work everyone. We'll run a blameless postmortem and schedule changes to avoid single-client blast radius: enforce per-client max rps and upstream hard-limits. :white_check_mark:
